import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static String[] sci, cap;
    static int[][] dis;
    static int[][][][][] dp;
    static int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};

    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow = 0;
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        final long INF = (long) 1e18;
        ArrayList<FlowEdge> edges;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;
        int n, m = 0, s, t;
        int[] level, ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(m);
            adj.get(u).add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            q.clear();
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj.get(v)) {
                    if (edges.get(id).cap - edges.get(id).flow < 1) continue;
                    if (level[edges.get(id).u] != -1) continue;
                    level[edges.get(id).u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(edges.get(id).u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int &cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj.get(v).size(); cid++) {
                int id = adj.get(v).get(cid);
                int u = edges.get(id).u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || edges.get(id).cap - edges.get(id).flow < 1) continue;
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, edges.get(id).cap - edges.get(id).flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                edges.get(id).flow += tr;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    f += pushed;
                }
            }
            return f;
        }
    }

    static boolean isValid(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n) return false;
        if (sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Z') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void bfs1(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], -1);
        dis[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int vx = u[0] + dx[i];
                int vy = u[1] + dy[i];
                if (isValid(vx, vy) && dis[vx][vy] == -1) {
                    dis[vx][vy] = 1 + dis[u[0]][u[1]];
                    q.add(new int[]{vx, vy});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (dis[i][j] == -1) dis[i][j] = 1000000000;
    }

    static int pos(int tt, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < tt) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (tt >= t) return 0;
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= tt) return 0;
        if (dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            int xx = x0 + dx[j];
            int yy = y0 + dy[j];
            if (xx < 0 || xx >= n) continue;
            if (yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
            if (sci[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y') continue;
            if (sci[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
            if (pos(tt + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
        }
        return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sci = new String[n];
        cap = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sci[i] = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cap[i] = sc.next();

        dis = new int[n][n];
        dp = new int[65][12][12][12][12];
        for (int a = 0; a < 65; a++)
            for (int b = 0; b < 12; b++)
                for (int c = 0; c < 12; c++)
                    for (int d = 0; d < 12; d++)
                        Arrays.fill(dp[a][b][c][d], -1);

        // Find first 'Z' and run BFS
        outer:
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    bfs1(i, j);
                    break outer;
                }
            }
        }

        ArrayList<int[]> scList = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<int[]> cpList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0')
                    scList.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = cap[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0')
                    cpList.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        int S = 0;
        int T = scList.size() + cpList.size() + 1;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(scList.size() + cpList.size() + 2, S, T);

        for (int i = 0; i < scList.size(); i++) {
            long c = sci[scList.get(i)[0]].charAt(scList.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            dinic.addEdge(0, i + 1, c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < cpList.size(); i++) {
            long c = cap[cpList.get(i)[0]].charAt(cpList.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            dinic.addEdge(scList.size() + 1 + i, T, c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < scList.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < cpList.size(); j++) {
                if (pos(0, scList.get(i)[0], scList.get(i)[1], cpList.get(j)[0], cpList.get(j)[1]) == 1)
                    dinic.addEdge(i + 1, scList.size() + 1 + j, 10000000);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.flow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
